findings.summary: Whole-snapshot read-modify-write can lose concurrent task updates.
findings.recommendation: Revisioned optimistic concurrency and explicit stale-write rejection are implemented; add reload-and-reconcile behavior and append-only transition records next.

findings.summary: Session, ticket, and handoff stores are process-local.
findings.recommendation: Use a shared repository for multi-worker deployment or enforce documented single-process mode.

findings.summary: Initial hydration made nine requests plus up to 20 project-detail requests.
findings.recommendation: Project file metadata is now included in the project-list response; the remaining nine-panel fan-out should be consolidated or lazily loaded next.
Implemented process-local revocation, logout, serialized stores, and five-failure window throttle.

findings.summary: Cookie secure behavior was implicit and path was not explicit.
findings.recommendation: Implemented environment-aware secure default, Path=/, and logout deletion.

findings.summary: Raw synchronous-handler exception text was agent-visible.
findings.recommendation: Implemented generic agent-visible failure with detailed server-side logging.

findings.summary: CSP and credentialed CORS are broader than necessary.
findings.recommendation: Derive policy from actual assets and restrict directives, methods, headers, and origins.

findings.summary: Orchestrator shutdown is registered in bootstrap and called directly in web lifespan.
findings.recommendation: Orchestrator shutdown is now idempotent; designate one lifecycle owner and add repeated start/stop tests.

findings.summary: Runtime reset clears only the assistant singleton.
findings.recommendation: Add coordinated reset hooks for global runtime, event, queue, and tool state.

findings.summary: Per-log-line task fan-out had no bounded per-client queue.
findings.recommendation: Broadcasts now await bounded 0.5-second per-client sends; a per-client queue remains the next improvement for sustained high-volume logs.

findings.summary: Legacy and canonical tool registries coexist.
findings.recommendation: Make ToolRuntime authoritative and retain a checked compatibility adapter during migration.
Extract context, command routing, conversation persistence, and execution-loop services.

findings.summary: Boolean("false") incorrectly displayed approval/configuration flags as true.
findings.recommendation: Implemented strict boolean normalization and covered through build verification.

findings.summary: Rejected panels were represented as empty arrays and could look healthy.
findings.recommendation: The snapshot now carries optional panelHealth states; screens still need to render panel-specific error and retry affordances.

findings.summary: Whole-row INSERT OR REPLACE and many JSON blobs complicate queryability and consistency.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit upserts, schema versions, append-only evidence, and normalized operational fields.

findings.summary: Generated pycache/pyc files obscure source inventory.
findings.recommendation: Use source-only inventory scripts and keep generated artifacts excluded.

findings.summary: Static-analysis wrapper did not yield reliable result artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded CI commands with explicit exit-code capture and uploaded reports.

verification.frontend_build: passed after project-file hydration and panel-health changes
verification.ruff_pyright_bandit: inconclusive; wrapper did not produce reliable artifacts
